---
title: "`r params$team`"
output: 
  html_document:
    toc: false
params:
  team: 'VAN'
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(htmltools)
library(sportyR)
tm = params$team
info <- read.csv('data_prep/RJMLteaminfo.csv') |> filter(Team == tm) |> select(Team,Full_team,Logo_url,Manager,Park,team_color)
#info <- scrape_info(tm) #returns vector c(team,logo_url, manager,park,position,record,color))
#page_title <- info[1]
page_title <- paste0('<span style="font-weight: bold;color:',info[1,6],'">',info[1,2], '</span>',' - ','<span style="color: black;font-size=.5em">',info[1,4], '</span>')
draft <- read.csv(paste0('data/',tm,'_draft.csv'))
draft26 <- read.csv('data/draft26_long.csv')
draft25 <- read.csv('data/draft25_long.csv')
hit <- read.csv(paste0('data/',tm,'_hit.csv'))
pit <- read.csv(paste0('data/',tm,'_pit.csv'))
teamPA <- sum(hit$PA)
teamGS <- sum(pit$GS)
teamBF <- sum(pit$BF)-25*teamGS
pos_order <- c("c", "1b", "2b", "3b", "ss", "lf", "cf", "rf", "dh")
```


<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;"><img src=`r info[1,3]` alt="Logo" style="height: 70px;"><div style="text-align: center;font-size:1.5em; line-height: 1.4;">`r info[1,2]`<br><span style="font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: normal;">`r info[1,4]`</span></div></div>

## Roster 


::: {.table-container}

::: {.table-box}

**2027 Draft Picks**

```{r}
draft |> 
  kbl(format = 'html',
      booktabs = T,
      col.names = c('Pick','Player')) |>
  column_spec(c(1,2), background ='wheat') |> 
  column_spec(column = 2, width = "20em") |>
  kable_styling(htmltable_class = "table table-striped rounded-table",
                font_size = 16,
                full_width = F)
```

:::


::: {.table-box}

**Hitters** Total PA = `r teamPA`

```{r}
hit |> 
  mutate(Pos = factor(Pos, levels = pos_order)) %>%
  arrange(desc(PA)) |> 
  arrange(Pos) |> 
  select(Name,Age,Pos,all_pos,PA,RC27) |>
  kbl(format = 'html',
      booktabs = T) |> 
  kable_styling(htmltable_class = "table table-striped rounded-table",
                font_size = 14, 
                full_width = F,
                fixed_thead = T)
```
:::

::: {.table-box}

**Pitchers** Total Starts = `r teamGS`; Relief BF $\approx$ `r teamBF`

```{r}
pit |> select(Name,Age,St,Rel,GS,BF,RC27) |>
  arrange(desc(GS),desc(BF)) |>
  kbl(format = 'html',
      booktabs = T) |> 
  kable_styling(htmltable_class = "table table-striped rounded-table",
                font_size = 14, 
                full_width = F,
                fixed_thead = T)
```
:::

### Depth Chart

```{r depthchart-data, echo=F}
dc_hit <- hit |> 
  select(Name,Pos,PA,RC27)

sorted_hit <- dc_hit |> 
  mutate(Pos = factor(Pos, levels = pos_order)) |> 
  arrange(desc(PA)) |> 
  group_by(Pos)

top_2 <- sorted_hit |> 
  slice(1:2) |> 
  ungroup()

other_hit <- sorted_hit |> 
  slice(-(1:2)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  arrange(desc(PA))

dc_hit <- dc_hit |> 
  mutate(Pos = factor(Pos, levels = pos_order)) |> 
  arrange(Pos,desc(PA))

dc_pit <- pit |> 
  select(Name,Pos,GS,BF,RC27)
dc_sp <- dc_pit |> filter(Pos == 'sp') |> select(-BF) |> arrange(desc(GS)) |> slice(1:6)
colnames(dc_sp) <- colnames(dc_hit)
dc_rp <- dc_pit |> filter(Pos != 'sp',BF>=150) |> select(-GS) |> arrange(RC27) |> slice(1:5)
dc_rp$Pos = 'rp'
colnames(dc_rp) <- colnames(dc_hit)
pit_names <- unique(c(dc_rp$Name,dc_sp$Name))
other_pit <- dc_pit |> filter(!Name %in% pit_names)
roster <- rbind(top_2,dc_sp,dc_rp)
```

:::: {.colummns}

::: {.column width="75%"
}
```{r depth-chart, fig.width=9, fig.height=5,dpi=150}
# 2. Define X, Y coordinates on the sportyR field (in feet from home plate)
pos_coords <- tribble(
  ~Pos, ~x,   ~y,
  "sp",    0,   80,
  "rp", -140, 40,
  "c",    0,  -18,
  "1b",  110,   110,
  "2b",  60,  165,
  "ss", -60,  165,
  "3b", -110,   110,
  "lf",-130,  230,
  "cf",   0,  240,
  "rf", 130,  230,
  "dh", 140,   40   # Placed near the first-base dugout
)
#pos_coords$x <- pos_coords$x*.8
pos_coords$y <- pos_coords$y*.8+10
# 3. Group by position, sort by PA (descending), and build the text box per position
depth_chart_df <- roster %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  mutate(line = sprintf("%s (%d | %.1f)", Name, PA, RC27)) %>%
  summarise(
    label = paste0(first(Pos), "\n", paste(line, collapse = "\n")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(pos_coords, by = "Pos")

# 4. Draw the baseball field and overlay the depth chart labels
geom_baseball(league = "MLB",
                color_updates = list(
                  #plot_background = "#7CFC00",
                  infield_grass = "#78a66f"),
              xlims = c(-190,190),
              ylims = .8*c(-20, 270)) +
  geom_label(
    data = depth_chart_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = alpha("lightgray", 0.90),
    color = "#1a1a1a",
    label.padding = unit(0.35, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    lineheight = 1.15
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(tm,"Depth Chart"),
    subtitle = "(Stats shown: Usage (PA or GS or BF) | RC27)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = 'white',hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = 'white', hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5, margin = margin(b = 10))
  )
```

## Hitters 

### Total PA = `r teamPA`


```{r, results="asis"}
hit |> mutate(AVG = AVG*1000,OBP = OBP*1000,SLG = SLG*1000, OPS = OPS*1000) |> 
  arrange(desc(PA)) |> 
  kbl(format = 'html',
      booktabs = T) |> 
  kable_styling(font_size = 15,
                full_width = F,
                fixed_thead = T,
                bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive"))|>
  scroll_box(height = "450px")
```

## Pitchers 

### Total GS = `r teamGS`; Relief BF $\approx$ `r teamBF`

```{r}
pit |> 
  mutate(OPS = OPS*1000) |>
  arrange(desc(GS),desc(BF)) |>
  kbl(col.names = c('Pitcher','Age','Pos','SDur','RDur','GS','INN','BF','ERA','WHIP','K','BB','OPS','RC27','K%','BB%','HR9')) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 15,
                full_width = F,
                fixed_thead = T,
                bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive"))|>
  scroll_box(height = "450px")
```
